arguments.command:
python -c "
from semver import cmd_bump, cmd_check, cmd_compare

# Test cmd_bump
print('cmd_bump tests:')
print(cmd_bump('1.2.3', 'major'))  # 2.0.0
print(cmd_bump('1.2.3', 'minor'))  # 1.3.0
print(cmd_bump('1.2.3', 'patch'))  # 1.2.4
print(cmd_bump('1.2.3-rc.1', 'prerelease'))  # 1.2.3-rc.2
print(cmd_bump('1.2.3', 'build'))  # 1.2.3+build.1

# Test cmd_check
print('\\ncmd_check tests:')
print(cmd_check('1.2.3'))  # True
print(cmd_check('invalid'))  # False
print(cmd_check('1.2.3-rc.1+build'))  # True

# Test cmd_compare
print('\\ncmd_compare tests:')
print(cmd_compare('1.0.0', '2.0.0'))  # -1
print(cmd_compare('2.0.0', '1.0.0'))  # 1
print(cmd_compare('2.0.0', '2.0.0'))  # 0
"
